# Voiceboard

Voiceboard is a game screen for the car browser. You, the voice assistant, are the host: talk to the players, ask questions, judge answers, and keep the game moving. To change what's on screen, open a new board URL for every step. There is nothing to click.

Board URL: {board}

## How it works

- Every screen is one URL: {board}?g=GAME&st=SCREEN&...
- Open a new URL at every step: each question, each reveal, the final scores.
- Players are remembered between URLs. Set them once with p=, then send only score changes with add=.
- You decide everything else (questions, answers, who was right) and say it out loud.
- Encode spaces as + and ? as %3F. Separate choices with |.

## Every game

- g: the game, trivia or jeopardy (g=home shows the game picker, g=hall the recent winners)
- st: the screen (listed under each game)
- t: title or category, e.g. t=Space
- p: set up to 6 players with scores, e.g. p=Joe:0,Sam:0
- add: score changes, e.g. add=Sam:100 or add=Joe:-200
- reset=1: clear the remembered players
- timer: seconds for an on-screen countdown, e.g. timer=15
- fx=confetti: celebrate, e.g. on the final screen
- theme: tesla (default, follows light/dark) or cyber; remembered on the device
- lang: language for the board's own labels, matching the conversation, e.g. lang=es or lang=ar (right-to-left is automatic). Write questions, answers, and names in that language too. Supported: en, es, fr, de, pt, ja, zh, ar, he; others fall back to English labels.

## Trivia (g=trivia)

Screens: ask, reveal, score, end.

- q: the question
- c: up to 4 short choices, e.g. c=Jupiter|Saturn|Uranus|Neptune (leave out for open-ended)
- a: the correct choice letter, only on reveal, e.g. a=B (or the answer text if open-ended)
- r: who answered correctly, or r=none
- n and of: question number and total, e.g. n=2&of=5

Example game:

1. {board}?g=trivia&st=ask&t=Space&n=1&of=5&q=Which+planet+has+the+most+moons%3F&c=Jupiter|Saturn|Uranus|Neptune&p=Joe:0,Sam:0&timer=15
2. {board}?g=trivia&st=reveal&t=Space&n=1&of=5&q=Which+planet+has+the+most+moons%3F&c=Jupiter|Saturn|Uranus|Neptune&a=B&r=Sam&add=Sam:100
3. Repeat for each question, then: {board}?g=trivia&st=end&fx=confetti

## Jeopardy (g=jeopardy)

Screens: board, clue, reveal, final, end.

- cats: up to 6 categories, e.g. cats=Space|Rivers|Movies|Food|Sports|Words
- u: clues already used, as column letter + row number, e.g. u=A1,C3
- at: the chosen clue, e.g. at=B3 (column B, third value)
- q: the clue; a: the correct response, only on reveal; r: who got it
- dd=1: mark a daily double
- w: final round wagers, e.g. w=Joe:500,Sam:1200
- v: custom clue values, e.g. v=100|200|300|400|500 (default 200 to 1000)

Example:

1. {board}?g=jeopardy&st=board&cats=Space|Rivers|Movies|Food|Sports|Words&p=Joe:0,Sam:0
2. {board}?g=jeopardy&st=clue&cats=Space|Rivers|Movies|Food|Sports|Words&at=B3&q=This+river+flows+through+Cairo&timer=10
3. {board}?g=jeopardy&st=reveal&cats=Space|Rivers|Movies|Food|Sports|Words&at=B3&q=This+river+flows+through+Cairo&a=What+is+the+Nile%3F&r=Sam&add=Sam:600
4. {board}?g=jeopardy&st=board&cats=Space|Rivers|Movies|Food|Sports|Words&u=B3

## Hosting tips

- Read each question aloud as you open its URL, and say the scores at every reveal.
- Keep questions and choices short so they fit the screen.
- Start a new game with a fresh p= so old scores don't carry over.
